This article is a stub. Essef Corporation was an Ohio water-treatment and pool equipment company,
owner of Pac-Fab, that acquired [General Aquatics](general-aquatics.md) and with it
[Paragon Aquatics](paragon-aquatics.md) in 1997, and was bought by [Pentair](pentair.md) in 1999.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
